flash_lite_quotes_verified.quote: And the biggest pain of cybersecurity when you come from the offensive war to the defensive war, the biggest pain is we don't have enough operators to operate all the different vulnerabilities.
I was a part of maybe the best cybersecurity services in the world, I'm not kidding. The name is Mandiant.
Today, it's like kind of simple, you do scan, right? And then you say, okay, have like, I'm not kidding, like when I say 30 million vulnerabilities, these are the real numbers we are seeing.
So, from threat analysis, we move to the risk analysis and we bubble it up by understanding the threat, but also the layers of the security.
And I believe the next generation of cybersecurity, it should look more like biology, when it's a self-healing platform...
